EnvAngelsOfDeath_Regional: At the beginning of the defender's third turn, {[nrOfSummons]} Jump Pack Intercessors are summoned supporting the defenders. Their stats depend on the average level of the defenders.
EnvArmourSupplies_Regional: All defending units have {[extraArmorPct]}% increased Armour.
EnvArtillerySupport_Regional: At the start of the battle {[nrOfProjectiles]} artillery shells hit random attacking units, each reducing the hit units' current Health by {[hpPct]}%.
EnvDefenderHealthBuff2_Global: All defending Characters have {[hpPct]}% increased Health.
EnvDefenderHealthBuff_Global: All defending Characters have {[hpPct]}% increased Health.
EnvFlakFire_Regional: At the start of the battle Anti-Air fire hits all attacking flying units, reducing the hit unit's current Health by {[hpPct]}%.
EnvFortified_Local: All defending units have {[extraArmorPct]}% increased Armour and {[extraDmgPct]}% increased Damage.
EnvGarrison_Global: At the start of the battle, summons {[nrOfSummons]} Cadian Guardsmen supporting the defenders. Their stats depend on the average level of the defenders.
EnvThinVeil_Global: Psyker Characters deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% more damage and when they are defeated, summon a random Daemon that has the same level as the defeated Psyker and is enemy to both attacker and defender.
EnvValkyrieStrike_Global: At the end of the first, third and fifth defender turn, marks a hex anywhere on the battlefield. At the beginning of the defender's next turn, the target hex and all surrounding hexes are hit with Hellstrike Missiles, each dealing {[nrOfHits]}x Blast Damage. The amount of damage depends on the rarity cap of the defenders.
